Short title and commencement

ACT XXIV OF 1994
SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXIV OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Buildings control Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th October,
1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-8/94, dated
4-10-1994.--The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 4th August, 1994 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 25th September, 1994 is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 2nd May, 1994. .

Amendment of section 19 of Ordinance V of 1979

ACT XXIV OF 1994
SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXIV OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Buildings control Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th October,
1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-8/94, dated
4-10-1994.--The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 4th August, 1994 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 25th September, 1994 is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh:--
2. Amendment of section 19 of Ordinance V of 1979.--In the Sindh
Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979, in section 19, in subsection (1-A) the full
stop at the end shall be replaced by a semi-colon and thereafter the following
proviso shall be added:--
"Provided
that no offence relating to building works commenced or carried out in
violation of the approved plans shall be compounded. "

Repeal of Sindh Ordinance No.X of 1994
